newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech utility to issue bond by end-June.
newsitem.headline: Czech utility to issue bond by end-June.

text.p: Czech electrical utility Elektrarny Opatovice a.s., on Thursday will issue a 2.5 billion crown tranche of six year bonds by the end of June, a company official said.
Pavel Hypius of Opatovice's finance department told Reuters that the coupon for the bonds would be at a fixed rate, but would be determined by market conditions at a time nearer the issue date.
Hypius said that funds from the issue would be used to refinance the firm's current debt load.
In 1996 Opatovice supplied consumers with 1,728 gigawatt hours (GWh) of electricity, up from 1,410 GWh in 1995, and 6,151 terrajoules (TJ) of heat, against 5,449 TJ the previous year.
The firm's main shareholders include investment funds SPIF Cesky (19.5 percent) and IPF Komercni Banka (14 percent), as well as Komercni Banka (9.9 percent).
